{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with revenue parsed
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders to avoid inflating revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel, stratified by customer_segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute total revenue by channel, stratified by customer_segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum().reset_index()

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel (ignoring segment)
overall_conversion = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
overall_conversion.rename(columns={'converted': 'overall_conversion_rate'}, inplace=True)

# Print results
print('Conversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

print('\nRevenue by channel and segment:')
print(revenue_by_channel_segment)

print('\nOverall conversion rate by channel:')
print(overall_conversion)"}
